reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkExternalAccount/linkBankAccount helper and balance handling joins the Akahu branch, but the transaction download is a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions rather than a shared function.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates downloadAkahuTransactions (and the Pluggy variant) line for line apart from the server URL and log text.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts its provider counterparts: server-config URL, accounts/app.ts link handler, accounts/sync.ts download and dispatch, types/models.

scope.why: Only the server-side wiring for the new provider is added.

maintainability.why: Follows established provider patterns; another near-identical download function adds to an existing family a maintainer must keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The link path uses linkExternalAccount; no abstraction exists for downloads that the change skips.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts is an undisguised copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.
